correctness.rationale: For n>=5 and the specified synchronous independent-attempt rule, the blue cycle stays an interval. The m=1 boundary uses a_1=89/80, while m>=2 two-endpoint recurrences distinguish whether 0/1/2 frontier leaves are blue. Solving their rational generating functions, the initial singleton correction, and the one final deterministic leaf-clearing round proves ept(S_n)=11n/16+4437/3344+(1323/6688)(-2/9)^(n-2)-(147/608)(-2/5)^(n-2), and a positive leaf-start disadvantage. Independent exact Fraction reconstruction confirmed the recurrence and both expressions for n=5..17, including ept(S_5)=1225469/256500. The general-n result follows from the algebraic rational-series identity and geometric error bound, not those finite tests.
